phases.title: Commercial hardening
phases.acceptance: About/identity, diagnostics, recent projects, autosave/recovery, close-safe, release policy, tests and Windows candidate.

phases.title: Workflow completeness
phases.acceptance: Undo/redo, portable bundles, PDF, onboarding/templates, batch and comparison/legacy UX with UAT.

phases.title: Commercial operations
phases.acceptance: Installer/portable, update policy, owner-selected licensing/activation, privacy, support and release notes.

phases.title: Measured data and validation
phases.acceptance: Measured packages, preregistered validation, uncertainty and bounded predictive claims. No invented parameters.

phases.title: Commercial acceptance
phases.acceptance: UAT, stability/performance, security/privacy, distribution and explicit owner release decision.

definition_of_done: CP0+CP1+CP2+CP4 closed and CP3 closed for every scientific claim included. Without measured data the product is TRIAL/engineering only.
